name: Kavita Singh

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Kavita Singh Prava writes in Hindi and is based in Delhi, according to her Kabita Live biography. Her poem “कठपुतलियाँ” brings questions of pride, impermanence and human agency into a direct, recurring address.

The image of puppets in time’s hands returns like a refrain, stripping away the distinctions between beggar and king. Yet the poem does not end in resignation: it asks the reader to break the cage of ego and leave a mark through action. What remains, it suggests, is the work one has done rather than the name one has carried.
